name: Choropleth Map
summary: Countries shaded by a metric on an offline world basemap — sequential or diverging, continuous or classed with nice-rounded breaks.
summary_zh: 在离线世界底图上按指标给国家着色：顺序/发散色阶，连续或分级（自动取整的分档）。
description_zh: 展示按国家汇总的指标（收入、增速、员工数、市场份额）的地理分布。每行数据一个国家，通过 ISO 3166-1 数字代码（如 "840"）、三字母代码（如 "USA"）或国家英文名与 Natural Earth 底图连接；无数据的国家保持浅色陆地底色。默认按分位数分 5 档并取整为好看的分界值（如 <$20 / $20–50 / …），图例显示每档国家数；增速、相对均值偏离等有正负含义的指标用 diverging 色阶并设置中点。前 N 个国家直接标注数值，悬停显示数值、排名和附加字段，点击国家可交叉筛选其他图表。底图默认 world-110m；需要放大到区域（如欧洲）或包含新加坡、香港、摩纳哥、巴林等微型国家 / 地区时设 basemap 为 world-50m（1:50m 精度，构建器仅在用到时打包）。底图中没有多边形但带经纬度（lat / lon）的行会以同色阶的小圆点绘制，图例注明“• shown as points”。同一国家有多行时可用 aggregate（sum / avg / max …）汇总。
best_for: Revenue / employees / market share by country
Growth vs. a benchmark (diverging around 0 or the group average)
avoid_when: Precise comparison of values (use a bar chart)
Totals dominated by large countries' area — consider bubble-map for absolute values

id.desc: Country key: ISO 3166-1 numeric ("840", zero-padded automatically), ISO alpha-3 ("USA") or a country name (common aliases such as "United States", "UK" understood)

label.desc: Display name for tooltips / labels; also a name fallback for the join

lat.desc: Latitude for rows the basemap has no polygon for (micro-states, territories): drawn as small circles in the same colour scale

basemap.desc: world-110m (default, 175 countries) | world-50m (1:50m Natural Earth: finer coastlines for zoomed-in regions, plus micro-states and territories such as Singapore, Hong Kong, Monaco, Bahrain, Malta; the builder ships vendor geo-world-50m only for blocks that ask for it) | any name registered with RK.geo.register

points.desc: Rows whose country has no polygon in the basemap (Singapore, Hong Kong … on world-110m) but that have lat / lon (encode.lat / encode.lon) are drawn as small circles in the same colour scale, with a legend note '• shown as points'

aggregate.desc: Several rows per country (e.g. deal corridors): null = the first row wins | sum | avg | median | min | max | count over the country's rows; numeric tooltip fields use the same aggregate

mid.desc: Diverging midpoint (0 for growth, or e.g. the group average)

bins.desc: Number of colour classes; 0 / null = continuous ramp. Diverging uses an even count (classes per side = bins / 2)

classify.desc: quantile | jenks | equal — how sequential class breaks are found. quantile / equal breaks are rounded to nice numbers; jenks (natural breaks: outliers get a class of their own) uses the roundest number between the two classes it separates

breaks.desc: Explicit class breaks, e.g. [50, 100, 250, 500] (overrides bins / classify)

format.desc: Value format; defaults to the value field format

labels.desc: Value callouts on the top N countries (largest |value - mid|); 0 = none. A callout sits on a large country, else beside it with a leader line where it covers the fewest other data countries; callouts that cannot be placed hide

tooltip.desc: Extra fields listed in the tooltip

fit.desc: Initial view: 'data' (countries with data) | 'world' | [[south, west], [north, east]] | {center: [lat, lon], zoom}

legend.desc: Show the colour legend (with country counts per class)

legendTitle.desc: Legend title; defaults to the value field title

legendPosition.desc: Leaflet control corner: bottomleft | bottomright | topleft | topright. The initial view reserves a column or band for the legend whenever it would cover a data country

filterField.desc: Field used for click-to-filter; defaults to encode.id. Use 'country' to link with assets_locations. Shared business dimensions (country, company, sector, region, segment, year…) filter the whole report; other fields (site name, type, from / to…) only this block's dataset — set crossFilterScope to override

scrollZoom.desc: Plain mouse-wheel zoom: 'click' (armed after clicking the map, so page scrolling is never hijacked) | true | false. Ctrl/Cmd + wheel or a trackpad pinch always zooms; +/- buttons and drag too

interactions: Hover highlight + tooltip (value, rank, extra fields)
Click a country to cross-filter (dims the others)
Ctrl/⌘ + wheel or pinch to zoom; drag to pan; +/− buttons (plain wheel scrolls the page until the map is clicked)
Micro-states / territories without a polygon shown as coloured points (same scale, hover and click)
Smooth colour transitions when filters change
